## Auth
All API requests require:
```
Authorization: Bearer nfp_YfWhZCYLjYQatPEcpjDPB5WGRD8RRKaGec87
```

## Endpoints

### POST /api/scrape — Submit batch scrape
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://6a7fba0ba3bffe9e51e12005--transcendent-cheesecake-03f934.netlify.app/api/scrape' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer nfp_YfWhZCYLjYQatPEcpjDPB5WGRD8RRKaGec87' \
  -d '{"jobs":[{"url":"https://example.com","engine":"fetch"}],"result_mode":"blob"}'
```

### Blob reads (PAT required, NO function call needed)
```
Site ID: 01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe
Store:   site:scraper-results
```

Read result:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer nfp_YfWhZCYLjYQatPEcpjDPB5WGRD8RRKaGec87" \
  'https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results/result/<batch_id>-<index>'
```

Read status:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer nfp_YfWhZCYLjYQatPEcpjDPB5WGRD8RRKaGec87" \
  'https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results/status/<batch_id>'
```

## Engines: fetch | chrome_impersonate | puppeteer
## Modes: blob | inline | metadata | auto
## Limits: 50 jobs sync, 500 queue, 5 concurrency sync, 10 queue
